Dysentery is a Slam Grindcore band from Massachusetts, US. The first incantation of the band formed in 2002 and since has recorded and distributed many records on thier own or with little help from record labels. The "slaughtered remnants" demo(2003), split with Gutrot(2004)(last recording with all original members), From past suffering comes new flesh"(2008), Promotional Demo (2009), and The upcoming "Internal Devastation" (2010).

From the first incantation of Dysentery(2002-2005), Will Caruso(Vocals), is the only Original Member. Drummer Eric Taranto was the 2nd generation Drummer(2006-) and Guitarist Pete "Blue" Spinazola joined(2007), but originally as a Bass player. Drew Will-Copeland the current bassist was originally offered the position by Blue(a member of Parasitic Exasporation, to which Blue is also Guitarist). All of the members are native to the local Boston Area, more specifically Waltham, Ma.
